products.name: Colossyan
products.note: AI video avatars; enterprise training; consent management; UK-hosted

reading.body:
Colossyan converts training documents into AI-generated video courses using hundreds of synthetic avatars and voiceovers, hosted in the UK for enterprise customers.

The platform reduces the labor cost of producing training content by automating video generation from existing materials. This is a narrow application of generative video: the user provides source material and editorial control, and the system fills in execution. The company positions itself as enterprise-focused rather than consumer-facing, which shapes both its feature set and its hosting choice.

For AI infrastructure, Colossyan is a consumer of compute that runs on someone else's servers. It does not tell us where that compute runs, how much of it the company uses, or whether it faces constraints in scaling to more customers. The UK hosting note indicates a data residency decision, not power or building capacity.

The data does not cover funding, team size, customer count, revenue, or growth trajectory. It does not show whether Colossyan is compute-bound, and therefore does not reveal where the actual constraint on its expansion lies.

profile_text.body:
Colossyan is an AI video platform that, per its own site, turns existing knowledge such as documents, briefs, or raw expertise into training and enablement content. The company describes its Colossyan Creator product as an AI video generator with real actors that can produce videos in less than 5 minutes. It offers more than 300 stock AI avatars powered by NEO 2, custom avatars created from a single photo, and cartoon presenters, all speaking more than 100 languages.

The site positions Colossyan as a full platform rather than a video-only tool. It says the platform handles video creation, course structure, interactivity, localization, and delivery in one workflow, including video and course creation from PDFs and presentations, interactive elements such as branching scenarios and quizzes, multi-language localization, team collaboration, versioning without re-recording, and SCORM export for LMS delivery. The company also offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

Colossyan is tracked as a product in the video generation and editing category, with notes on AI video avatars, enterprise training, consent management, and UK hosting. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded.
